description: Household resident and visitor persona pool for lifespan household dynamics generation. Profiles are designed to cover common family-scene roles and activity patterns. Version 1.1 adds explicit name, age, gender, routine_preferences, personality, occupation, thoughts, and preferences fields for LLM household planning.
intended_use: sample persistent residents for a household
assign object ownership and room preferences
generate weekly routines and household events
control activity-driven object movement in lifespan layouts
